description: HydroGenerate provides Python calculations of hydropower generation from flow rates and hydraulic head. IdahoLabResearch publishes the package to estimate technical generation potential, including applications to existing hydropower sites and non-powered dams described in its documentation. Users may supply their own flow series or obtain flow data from United States Geological Survey services. Consequently, the built-in data route concerns the United States, while portability to other locations depends on user inputs. The time span and temporal resolution follow the supplied flow record, not a fixed packaged dataset. Source code is available on GitHub and installation is documented through PyPI. GitHub states the BSD-3-Clause licence, permitting free reuse. The model estimates turbine efficiency from flow and a selected or head-derived turbine type. Limitations include dependence on those assumptions and the absence of a verified site-specific engineering assessment in this review. Generation estimates can support energy-resource screening and capacity planning. Related record model-pypsa provides broader electricity-system modelling, but a direct software connection was not established. No flow data were downloaded and no model was run.
